title: World War I — Eastern Front
key_facts: Theater of operations between Russia and Central Powers
More mobile warfare than Western Front but equally devastating
Major battles: Tannenberg (1914), Gorlice-Tarnów (1915), Brusilov Offensive (1916)
Russian collapse and withdrawal after 1917 revolutions
causes: Russian alliance with Serbia against Austro-Hungarian expansion
German and Austro-Hungarian desire to eliminate Russian threat
Russian industrial and military backwardness vs German efficiency
outcome: Russian military collapse and withdrawal from war after 1917
German victory but at massive cost to both sides
Enabled Germany to focus forces on Western Front in 1918
Led to Russian Revolution and establishment of Soviet Union
impacts: Catalyzed Russian Revolution and collapse of Tsarist regime
Demonstrated limitations of Russian military and industrial capacity
Contributed to eventual German defeat through overextension
Redrew Eastern European borders and created new nations
